title: Transformation program with rotating sponsorship
observations: Executive sponsorship changes three times in one year.
Business units receive conflicting implementation priorities.
The transformation office has coordination responsibility but no authority over unit resources.
Decisions are reopened after sponsor changes.
participant_claims: Unit leaders say the transformation office creates bureaucracy.
researcher_interpretations: Sponsor instability and structural authority gaps may jointly undermine execution.
assumptions: A central program office can coordinate without decision authority.
